title: The gate's workflow check covers only .github/workflows package wildcards; other path-naming configs still rot invisibly
body: The cwa check asserts ./x/... package wildcards in .github/workflows only. The tick's own general shape names CODEOWNERS, lint include lists and release manifests, and bare ./x input paths in workflow run lines (e.g. `test -x ./scripts/deploy.sh`), as configs that can rot behind a green gate the same way. Each needs its own false-positive analysis (bare paths can be build outputs), so each is a separate check rather than a widening of cwa's. Low severity: nothing is known to be rotted today; this is hardening.
